text:
1 scam report recorded in Chesterfield for week ending July 18, 2026
For the week ending July 18, 2026, Chesterfield had one scam report, according to Better Business Bureau.
That matched the number of reports from the previous week.
One report listed dollar amounts, with reported losses totaling $94.
The largest reported loss was $94 and involved an online purchase scam. The report stated: "Products were not delivered despite paying additional insurance to ensure delivery. 50+ emails with Kayla and 4 months later with constant promises of prioritzation have not resulted in delivery of products. SCAM company."
BBB Scam Tracker lets consumers search reported scams and share their experiences to help others spot similar schemes. The BBB says it reviews each report before publication and does not publicly display the reporter’s name or personal contact information.
Fraud reports nationwide have continued to show large financial losses. The Federal Trade Commission said consumers reported losing more than $12.5 billion to fraud in 2024, a 25% increase from the previous year.
